tasks.title: Bootstrap repository and file-backed harness
acceptance_criteria: STATE.md, TASKS.json, LOG.md, OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, PROCESS.md and Phase 0 question/handoff files exist
TASKS.json parses as JSON and every dependency references an existing task id
No feature implementation files exist

tasks.title: Research GPUI internals and clean-room boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file contains question, dated primary sources, findings, confidence, contradictions and recommendation
Each decision-driving claim is labelled verified, plausible or unverified
Handoff follows Part 3 schema and LOG.md contains an action line

tasks.title: Research cross-framework retained/immediate rendering models
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file compares at least Slint, Iced and one additional relevant framework using dated sources
Each decision-driving claim is labelled verified, plausible or unverified
Handoff follows Part 3 schema and LOG.md contains an action line

tasks.title: Research core Rust rendering/layout/text dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file records candidate versions, licenses, maintenance evidence, platform gaps and known bugs for winit, wgpu, taffy, cosmic-text, accesskit and rustc-hash/slotmap
Every recommended dependency has a dated primary source
Handoff follows Part 3 schema and LOG.md contains an action line

tasks.title: Research PyO3, maturin, abi3 and strict typing constraints
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file evaluates PyO3, maturin and relevant async/GIL integration against macOS, Windows and Linux abi3 wheels
mypy --strict public API strategy is supported by concrete tooling evidence
Each decision-driving claim is labelled verified, plausible or unverified

tasks.title: Research FFI/GIL and per-frame rendering cost models
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file explains where GIL transitions occur and proposes an event-only FFI boundary
Includes evidence for tree diffing, batching/instancing, text atlas and animation/scroll costs
Performance statements are estimates or measurements, never unlabelled assertions

tasks.title: Design reproducible performance benchmark protocol
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file defines workloads, warmup, sample counts, statistics, hardware disclosure and pass/fail commands for all requested targets
Protocol distinguishes headless frame cost from real display cadence and defines input-to-frame measurement
Includes baseline capture and greater-than-10-percent regression detection

tasks.title: Research desktop platform rendering and windowing constraints
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file covers Wayland/X11, Windows DX12/Vulkan and macOS Metal/HiDPI constraints with dated primary sources
Identifies platform-specific risks for wgpu and winit
Includes conservative recommendations for initial supported platforms

tasks.title: Research IME, accessibility and cross-platform distribution edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Assigned RESEARCH file covers IME lifecycle, AccessKit integration and keyboard/focus edge cases
Records wheel/CI/signing constraints for macOS, Windows and Linux without assuming unavailable infrastructure
Each decision-driving claim is labelled verified, plausible or unverified

tasks.title: Falsify and classify combined Phase 0 research
acceptance_criteria: REVIEWS/phase-0-research-skeptic.md cites each research file and identifies stale, contradictory or unsupported claims
Every architecture-driving claim has a final verified/plausible/unverified disposition
Round 2 requests are specific and only issued where the decision could change
No plausible or unverified claim silently drives an ADR

tasks.title: Draft accepted architecture decision records
acceptance_criteria: DECISIONS contains ADRs for runtime ownership, Python/Rust boundary, rendering pipeline, public API, dependency baseline, platform baseline, benchmark gate and licensing
Each ADR lists context, decision, alternatives rejected, consequences, status and evidence links
No ADR relies on an unverified claim without an explicit uncertainty record

tasks.title: Produce Phase 1 machine-checkable task graph
acceptance_criteria: Phase 1 tasks in TASKS.json have owners, deps, status, acceptance criteria, evidence links and attempt counts
Acceptance criteria name tests, benchmark thresholds or commands that exit zero
At least one thin end-to-end demoable vertical slice precedes broader framework work

tasks.title: Red-team the Phase 0 ADRs and Phase 1 plan
acceptance_criteria: REVIEWS/phase-0-plan-red-team.md checks dependencies, hidden coupling, estimates, rollback and acceptance-criteria quality
Findings are severity-tagged with exact file/task references
Report ends with zero blocking issues or an explicit list requiring revision

tasks.title: Approve Phase 0 gate and authorize Phase 1
acceptance_criteria: STATE.md records gate evidence and approved next phase
Every blocking red-team finding is resolved or has an explicit bounded exception
No Phase 1 build task starts before this task is marked done
